entries.036f490d6a8e4bac: A pharmaceutical company that researches and develops prescription pharmaceuticals such as XTANDI, a treatment for prostate cancer, and PADCEV, a treatment for urothelial cancer, and manufactures and sells them worldwide.
entries.0aacbe4462305d98: As there is a single pharmaceutical business segment, profit or loss by segment is not disclosed. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, operating profit was ¥382,633 million (up 832.4% from the previous consolidated fiscal year), profit before tax was ¥376,587 million, and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥291,535 million. The securities report cites growth in sales of PADCEV, IZERVAY, VYLOY and VEOZAH, an increase in XTANDI sales, and a reduction in other expenses from ¥235.8 billion to ¥72.4 billion.
